The project is an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for personal finance tracking, written in Python. Key files:

- server.py: Main MCP server, creates FastMCP app, registers tools and resources

### Business Logic / Models
- models/budget.py: Budget model with BudgetCategory (name, allocated, spent), Budget (category_budgets, month), create_default_budgets()
- models/account.py: Account model (id, name, type, balance, currency)
- models/transaction.py: Transaction model (id, account_id, type: income/expense/transfer, amount, category, description, date, tags)
- models/__init__.py: Exports all models
- models/recurring.py: RecurringTransaction, RecurringExpense, RecurringIncome models
- models/bill.py: Bill model (id, name, amount, due_date, category, paid, recurring, auto_pay, account_id)
- models/goal.py: Goal, GoalContribution models
- models/debt.py: Debt model (id, name, total_amount, paid_amount, interest_rate, minimum_payment, due_date)

- storage.py: InMemoryStorage singleton with dicts for accounts, transactions, budgets, goals, debts, bills, categories, recurring_items. - tools/transaction_tools.py: add_transaction (account_id, type, amount, category, description, tags, date), get_transactions (account_id, category, start_date, end_date, type, tags, page, page_size=20), update_transaction (transaction_id, fields...), delete_transaction (transaction_id)

- tools/bill_tools.py: add_bill (name, amount, due_date, category, paid, recurring, auto_pay, account_id), get_bills (paid, category), get_bill (bill_id), update_bill (bill_id, fields...), delete_bill (bill_id)
